name: Phoenix One Prompt Studio
original_description: Turn ideas into detailed AI image and cinematic video prompts tailored to your niche, brand and visual style. Explore 15 Phoenix One styles, lighting and camera direction, faceless and UGC concepts, product prompts, six creative angles, and matching image-to-video movement. Get ready-to-copy prompts or learn reusable frameworks. Includes an optional link to Phoenix Core for Phoenix One access and training. This skills-only plugin writes prompts; it does not generate media or connect to your Phoenix One account.

limitations_ja: プロンプトを作成するスキルで、画像・動画の生成やPhoenix Oneアカウントへの接続は行わない。
